note: Deep-dive #9. The Office 365 sign-in is made inside CON-W11-01 as alex.demo. Log entries lag a few minutes. Order: policies, Intune (BitLocker failing), sign-in failure, fix, success, impact, then the network demo.
prepare: # owner signs in (device code), not recorded
# manual: Entra admin center > Mobility > Microsoft Intune > MDM user scope = Some, group ct-zt-pilot (write down the previous value)
# manual: start CON-W11-01 (Hyper-V), finish Windows setup by joining Entra as alex.demo; confirm it appears in Intune > Devices > Windows
# manual: add alex.demo and sam.demo to ct-zt-pilot and labadmin to ct-zt-breakglass
az group create -n rg-mglab-deep-dive-09 -l westeurope -o none
az vm list-skus -l westeurope --size Standard_B1s -o table

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-deep-dive-09 -f infra/main.bicep -p adminPublicKey="$(Get-Content ./zt-lab.pub -Raw)" --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; $env:MG_VAULT09 = $o.vaultName.value; $env:MG_VM09 = $o.vmName.value

# manual (inside CON-W11-01): sign in to https://outlook.office.com as alex.demo in Edge, sync the device (Settings > Accounts > Access work or school > Info > Sync); if BitLocker is already on use Disable-BitLocker for the 'before' take

screens.name: ca-policies
steps: Entra admin center > Entra ID > Conditional Access > Policies
Show CT001, CT002 and CT003, each with State 'Report-only'

screens.name: intune-compliance
steps: Intune admin center > Devices > Windows > CON-W11-01 > Device compliance
Open the policy 'CT Windows corporate baseline': per-setting status with BitLocker Not compliant (take this before enabling BitLocker)

screens.name: signin-report-only
steps: Take 1: Entra ID > Monitoring > Sign-in logs > the Office 365 sign-in of alex.demo from CON-W11-01 > Report-only tab: CT003 Failure
Fix inside CON-W11-01 (elevated PowerShell): Enable-BitLocker -MountPoint C: -TpmProtector -UsedSpaceOnly (restart if asked), sync the device, wait for Compliant
Take 2: the next sign-in: CT003 Success

Take 3 (terminal on the laptop, after Connect-MgGraph as labadmin): Get-CaReportOnlyImpact -Hours 3 after Import-Module ./scripts/ZeroTrust.psm1 -Force: CT001 to CT003 with WouldPass, WouldFail, UserActionNeeded, NotApplied

screens.name: private-access
also: OUTSIDE: the vault name resolves to a public address and the call fails with Forbidden. INSIDE (VM run-command): 10.60.0.x, 'got a token', HTTP 200, the internet call fails.
Second capture (browser, labadmin): portal > Key Vault > Networking: public network access Disabled, and Private endpoint connections: Approved

teardown: # manual: delete CT001-CT003 in Entra, the Intune policy 'CT Windows corporate baseline', groups ct-zt-pilot and ct-zt-breakglass; set MDM user scope back to its previous value; retire/delete CON-W11-01 in Intune and Entra if the VM is rebuilt

Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method GET -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty value | Where-Object displayName -like 'CT0*' | ForEach-Object { Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method DELETE -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identity/conditionalAccess/policies/$($_.id)" }
az keyvault purge --name $env:MG_VAULT09 --location westeurope   # soft-deleted vault names stay reserved for 7 days otherwise
Remove-Item ./zt-lab, ./zt-lab.pub -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item Env:MG_VAULT09, Env:MG_VM09 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
